description:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of plan-only and Atlassian teams in a plan.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The cursor to start from. If not provided, the first page will be returned.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: The maximum number of plan teams to return per page. The maximum value is 50. The default value is 50.
parameters.name: maxResults

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

401.description: Returned if the user is not logged in.

403.description: Returned if the site has no premium edition of Jira or if the user does not have the Administer Jira global permission.

404.description: Returned if the plan is not found.
